events.label: July CPI (8:30 AM ET) — arrives with CRWV $104B backlog positive and 3-of-6 regime active
events.note: Updated Aug 11 night: CRWV Q2 clean beat (backlog $104B, Meta $21B + Anthropic + Jane Street diversify away from MSFT concentration; AH +13%) changes AI-demand context but not oil or 30Y setup. WTI ~$82 and Brent $88.23 — both triggers still active; oil retreat on Tuesday morning did not hold through close. 30Y ~5.22% (est.), ~22bps above 5.00% threshold. September hike odds ~50% CME. CPI consensus: 3.4% YoY headline, 2.5% core. Kalshi <55% chance above 3.3% — market skews slightly soft. Below 2.9%/3.2%: 30Y compresses, oil triggers treated transient, September below 25%, CRWV AH and NVDA read-through compound. Above 3.2%/3.5%: Kashkari's supply-shock thesis confirmed with labor already negative; 30Y to 5.30%+; CRWV AH partially unwound. Ambiguous: Jackson Hole (Aug 27) decides. Invalidation: SPX closes below 7,600 within two sessions.

events.label: SPCX next staggered tranche (~7%) — second unlock after Aug 6 first tranche
events.note: Updated Aug 10 morning: Day 5 (Aug 10) closed $133.11, up 15.83% from Day 3's $114.92 — 20% first tranche absorbed above the $105 floor. Terafab Texas AI compute megafactory (SpaceX + Tesla JV, $16.8B, announced Aug 8) provided the incremental catalyst. Next staggered tranche (~7%, ~65M shares, ~$8.65B eligible) expected around Aug 20. Absorption thesis: close above $128 through CPI (Aug 12). Front-run signal: close below $115 on elevated volume before Aug 20 means the next tranche is being pre-sold. CPI Wednesday is the binary: soft → rate compression extends absorption window; hot → simultaneous multiple compression and supply pressure. Morgan Stanley $140, Bernstein $248, Citi $200 targets; 28 of 30 analysts Buy. October Q3 earnings (Starlink profitability, AI segment above $2.56B) is the narrative anchor.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — SpaceX Vera Rubin exclusive raises gross-margin bar
events.note: Updated Aug 10 night: NVDA pulled back from $223.96 (Friday close) on Monday as chips led the session lower. Three active regime conditions — 30Y 5.21%, WTI $80.42, Brent $87.69 — entering the final two-week setup window. At ~$217-220, Q2 FY27 call watch: (1) Gross margin above 76% — SpaceX $15.83B AI capex commitment raises the demand floor but AMD −8% AH from $518 and DDOG −17% on a beat-and-raise establish that altitude amplifies disappointment at current prices. (2) Q3 guide above consensus — SpaceX 10GW and hyperscaler pipeline confirm demand; guide at consensus rather than above replays the AMD template. Jackson Hole keynote Aug 27 begins one day after earnings — no de-risk window. If CPI is ambiguous and three conditions remain active through August 26, the macro headwind compounds the altitude risk. $216 is structural support.

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27–29) — Warsh keynote after NFP + CPI
events.note: Updated Aug 7 night: September hike now at 36% (Kalshi) after NFP −23K collapsed odds from 54%. Warsh keynote arrives after both NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 13). At 36%, 'live meeting' language would be a shock; 'data-dependent, watching oil and labor' is the base path. NFP removed the wage-inflation channel; CPI determines whether supply-inflation remains. If CPI is above 3.5%, Kashkari's three-dissenter bloc is validated and Warsh's Jackson Hole language is the final gate. If CPI is below 3.0%, Warsh de-escalates and 30Y retreats toward 5.00%. NVDA earnings land Aug 26 — one day before the keynote, with no de-risk window.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — terminal insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are the known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Context after Aug 6-7: 20% first tranche absorbed at $105-$115; next tranches scheduled Aug 20 and late September. Q3 Starlink profitability (~October call) is the only fundamental catalyst that could revalue the lockup discount before the December terminal release. SPCX Q2: $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue; AI segment $2.56B (+247% YoY).

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). PLTR's 149% US commercial growth, AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%), and SpaceX's exclusive Nvidia commitment ($15.83B AI capex) confirm the enterprise AI adoption underlying OpenAI's revenue model. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.
